icons.name: ai-assistant
icons.heading: Assistant thinks, then replies
icons.description: Speech bubble with an orbit arc around a core.
icons.label: AI assistant
icons.intent: The orbit spins one full turn around the core; in Strong the core swells once as the answer forms.

brief.light: Orbit arc rotates 360° about (16,14) in .56s ease in-out; end pose equals start.
brief.strong: Arc winds back 14° (0–.12s), spins to 360° by .66s, holds; core swells r 1.3→1.7 (.68–.8s) and settles by 1s.
brief.fixed: Bubble body in both profiles. Moving: orbit arc (rotation), core (radius, Strong only).
brief.test: Core clearance inside orbit at peak swell: 1.25 at Bold outline, 1.1 in Solid; arc gap at top at t=0 and t=end; cycleDegrees boundary compare.

icons.name: prompt
icons.heading: User types a prompt
icons.description: Pill input with a chevron prompt mark and a bar cursor.
icons.label: Prompt
icons.intent: The cursor blinks, text is typed in three chunks, the prompt mark nudges as it submits.

brief.light: Typed line grows 15.2→19.2 in three eased chunks; cursor advances 4 units ahead of it, .56s.

icons.name: system-instructions
icons.heading: A rule is added under the root
icons.description: Root node with a spine and rules branching right, a directive tree.
icons.label: System instructions
icons.intent: The spine extends one level below the last rule, then a third rule writes out and stays.

brief.light: Spine descends 4.5 into a rounded elbow (0–.2s), rule 3 writes to x 27 (.2–.52s), hold.
brief.strong: Spine descends with ease in-out (.06–.32s), holds; rule writes in two chunks (.38–.58s, .66–.9s), hold to .98s.
brief.fixed: Node, spine, rules 1–2 in every style. Moving: rule 3 elbow path (point growth only).
brief.test: Degenerate elbow at t=0 is a round dot at (9,21.5) fully inside the spine/rule-2 junction in all weights; rule spacing 4.5 at Bold 24px; silhouette reads as hierarchy, not Document/Clipboard; reset fades only rule 3.

icons.name: context-window
icons.heading: The window advances over the text
icons.description: Fixed frame over two rows of token dashes.
icons.label: Context window
icons.intent: The oldest token drops out, the remaining tokens shift one slot left, a new token arrives on the right.

brief.light: Leftmost tokens fade in place (0–.12s), both rows slide 5.5 left ease in-out (.12–.45s), new tokens fade in at the right slot (.45–.55s).
brief.strong: Leftmost tokens fade (0–.14s); row 1 slides .16–.5s, row 2 follows .28–.62s; new tokens arrive .55–.67s and .68–.8s; hold to .9s.
brief.fixed: Frame in every style. Moving: two sliding tokens per row (dx), outgoing and incoming tokens (visibility only).
brief.test: No token touches the frame stroke at any frame; end pose visibly differs from start (row 1 lengths [.8,1.6,1.2] vs [2,.8,1.6]); reset fades tokens only, frame stays; Bold neighbour gap 1.0.
